## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, typecheck, build)

- [ ] Headings, titles and URLs do not mention the UK or the US (audience is signalled in body copy only)
- [ ] New pages are added to `src/app/sitemap.ts` and `SITE.contentUpdated` is bumped
- [ ] No secrets committed (use environment variables)
